Markets.title: IGI shares hit 10% upper circuit as Q2 profit jumps 43%, revenue rises 31% YoY
Markets.summary: International Gemological Institute shares hit the 10 percent upper circuit after reporting a 43 percent increase in Q2 profit. Revenue grew 31 percent year-on-year, driven by lab-grown diamonds, stronger margins, and higher demand for jewelry and colored gemstones.

Markets.title: Indian bonds steady after RBI minutes signal more rate hikes
Markets.summary: Indian bond yields remained steady at 7.45% after Reserve Bank of India minutes indicated that further interest rate hikes are likely following the recent increase to 5.50%. This monetary tightening is driven by rising oil prices and food inflation, with analysts expecting another rate increase in December.

Markets.title: Global Market: Bank of Korea holds interest rates at 3% after back-to-back hikes
Markets.summary: The Bank of Korea kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.00% on Thursday. This decision follows back-to-back 25-basis-point rate hikes in July and August.

Markets.title: Global Market: Nokia Q3 profit beats estimates on AI demand, maintains 2026 outlook
Markets.summary: Nokia reported a stronger-than-expected third-quarter operating profit and revenue growth due to a 118% surge in orders from AI and cloud customers. The company also maintained its full-year financial outlook.

Markets.title: Gold price falls Rs 2,000/10 gram; silver plunges Rs 6,000/kg as traders eye US Fed meet next week. Buy, sell or hold?
Markets.summary: On Thursday, gold prices on the MCX fell by Rs 2,000 per 10 grams and silver dropped by Rs 5,700 per kg as investors awaited the upcoming US Federal Reserve meeting and inflation data. Analysts recommend that long-term investors accumulate these metals gradually while traders wait for market stability.

Markets.title: Deepinder Goyal’s Dark.ai could be Eternal’s dark horse, but is it too early to bet?
Markets.summary: Deepinder Goyal's new privacy-focused AI assistant, Dark.ai, could become a significant growth driver for Eternal. However, because its pricing, monetization, and profitability remain untested, investors must wait to evaluate its true financial impact.

Geo-Political.summary: BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg states that current United States diplomatic efforts provide little hope for an immediate peace in Ukraine. He reports that Russian President Vladimir Putin currently feels no pressure to end the conflict.

Geo-Political.title: US orders some diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks escalate
Geo-Political.summary: The US government ordered some diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia due to escalating Houthi attacks. These recent strikes on an airport and an oil field resulted in at least three deaths.

Data & Insights.summary: Between 2022 and 2026, over 100 Indian lawmakers switched political parties by exploiting loopholes in the anti-defection law. The National Democratic Alliance emerged as the primary beneficiary of this defection wave across central and state levels.

Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that future interest rate hikes will depend on the evolving growth and inflation outlook. Policymakers shared differing views on how to balance controlling inflation without unnecessarily restricting economic activity.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC minutes reveal 2 members opposed shift from neutral stance to calibrated tightening in October meeting
Data & Insights.summary: Two of the six RBI Monetary Policy Committee members opposed shifting from a neutral stance to calibrated tightening during the October meeting. However, all six members supported raising the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth accelerates to 7.9% in September, fastest in new series
Data & Insights.summary: India's core sector growth accelerated to 7.9% in September, driven by double-digit increases in iron ore, electricity, coal, refinery products, and cement. Meanwhile, fertilizers, natural gas, and crude oil experienced production contractions during the same month.

Data & Insights.title: India's infrastructure output grows 7.9% year-on-year in September on strong coal, steel output
Data & Insights.summary: India's infrastructure output grew by 7.9% year-on-year in September, accelerating from the 3.1% growth recorded in the same month last year. This increase was driven primarily by higher production in the coal, refinery products, steel, and iron ore sectors.

Data & Insights.title: IMF urges currency flexibility as RBI steps up rupee defence amid oil price pressures, foreign outflows
Data & Insights.summary: The International Monetary Fund advises that currencies should adjust to global shocks rather than relying on limited short-term foreign-exchange intervention. This guidance comes as the Reserve Bank of India increases efforts to defend the rupee amid rising oil prices and foreign capital outflows.
